View All Jobs Join Log In For Employers Zalando Jobs Team Lead CRM Marketing Tech (all genders) Zalando Team Lead CRM Marketing Tech (all genders) Sorry, this job was removed at 12:11 p.m. (UTC) on Friday, May 09, 2025 Be an Early Applicant Berlin, DEU In-Office eCommerce • Retail The Role THE ROLE & THE TEAM The Lounge CRM Tech team oversees the development and maintenance of the CRM engagement platform Braze, utilized company-wide for all commercial and transactional communications to our customers across various B2C communication channels. In this role, you'll spearhead the strategy and execution of the Lounge CRM Messaging Tech Stack, which supports today the channels Email, Push Notifications, and In-Product Messaging. Your work ensures alignment with our overarching CRM strategy, driving effective automation, content management, and compliance outcomes. You’ll collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and senior leaders. You'll lead a cross-functional CRM Tech (CRM Tech Managers, Software Engineering, Email Development, 6 people) team. Your leadership will focus on fostering collaboration and creating solutions that streamline processes and cut down on manual tasks. Your ability to lead diverse job profiles and manage stakeholders effectively is crucial. You'll engage confidently with senior leadership (Director, VP, SVP level) to ensure alignment with CRM initiatives and articulate a strategic vision for the CRM tech stack, ensuring it integrates seamlessly with our broader tech strategy. INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN At Zalando, our vision is to be inclusive by design. And this vision starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. You are welcome to leave out your picture, age, or marital status from your application. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. We want to provide you with a great candidate experience. Feel free to inform us of any accommodations you may need, so we can best support you throughout the hiring process. do.BETTER - our diversity & inclusion strategy: https://corporate.zalando.com/en/our-impact/dobetter-our-diversity-and-inclusion-strategy WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING) Shape strategic direction: Drive the strategy, design, and implementation of our CRM Commercial, Transactional, and Lifecycle Messaging Tech Stack, including Email, Push Notifications, and In-Product Messaging. Align CRM tech initiatives with the CRM strategy through clear communication, structured decision-making, and cross-functional collaboration. Leverage technical expertise and foster collaboration : Utilize your advanced technical skills to manage and deliver impactful results across CRM channel automation, content retrieval, template management, and marketing compliance. Build strong collaborative relationships with internal teams and stakeholders, as well as external vendors and senior leaders, to drive success. Lead and develop a high-performing tech team : Guide the CRM Tech, CRM Software Engineering, and Email Development teams, fostering a culture of close collaboration. Develop innovative solutions to streamline processes, eliminate manual tasks, and reduce overhead, positively impacting other CRM teams. WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF You have proven team leadership : You have a strong track record of leading diverse teams, effectively managing different levels of seniority and technical expertise. You have strong experience in optimizing team efficiencies and managing team velocity. You ensure structure and prioritisation : You bring a strong sense of ownership, using data to drive prioritization, confidently pushing back when needed, and leading your team through ambiguity by creating focus, structure, and alignment across stakeholders. You bring exceptional stakeholder management : You excel at managing stakeholders, confidently communicating with upper management and senior leaders to ensure alignment and garner support for CRM initiatives. You have a strategic vision for the marketing tech stack : You can define and articulate a strategic vision for the Marketing Tech Stack, ensuring it aligns seamlessly with the broader Demand Tech stack. You are adept at setting clear requirements for integration into the overarching tech strategy. You bring a robust background in Marketing technologies and systems, preferably with experience in Braze. You bring software engineering acumen : You possess an understanding of back-end and data engineering principles, working closely with Product and Engineering teams to develop cloud-based solutions (AWS) and data solutions (Apache Kafka, Databricks) that support CRM Tech Stack development. OUR OFFER Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer. Employee shares program 40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Zalando Lounge, discounts from external partners 2 paid volunteering days a year Hybrid working model with 60% remote per week, actual practice is up to each team to best support their collaboration Work from abroad for up to 30 working days a year 27 days of vacation a year to start Relocation assistance available (subject to prior agreement) Family services, including counseling and support Health and wellbeing options (including Gympass) Mental health support and coaching available Learn all about Zalando and our values here: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/?gh_src=22377bdd1us ABOUT LOUNGE BY ZALANDO Lounge by Zalando is an online shopping club for fashion and lifestyle products in 17 European countries. We offer our members daily, time-limited sale campaigns with discounts of up to 75% off the recommended retail price. However, Lounge by Zalando is so much more than discounts. Our strength lies in our focus on fashion: from sought-after labels to niche brands, from famous international names to trendy luxury brands, we make sure to meet the fashion taste of all our customers, who are always on the hunt for the best products at the best prices. Working with our brand partners, we're pioneering innovative supply-chain and production processes and offer them an impactful and smart solution, creating a new way to shop for fashion - and a new way to sell it. https://www.zalando-lounge.de Please note that all applications must be completed using the online form - we do not accept applications via email. The Company HQ: Berlin 10,000 Employees Year Founded: 2008 What We Do Welcome to Zalando. Here’s some key info about us: Our position and vision: - We’re Europe’s leading online platform for fashion and lifestyle - Founded in Berlin in 2008, we bring head-to-toe fashion to more than 50 million active customers in 25 markets; offering clothes, footwear, accessories, and beauty - Our vision is to become The Starting Point For Fashion. Our offering: - Our assortment of international brands ranges from world-famous names to local labels - Our platform is a one-stop fashion destination for inspiration, innovation, and interaction - As Europe’s most fashionable tech company, we work hard to find digital solutions for every aspect of the fashion journey: for our customers, partners, and friends of our brand. - Our logistics network with 12 centrally located fulfillment centers allows us to efficiently serve our customers throughout Europe, supported by warehouses in Italy, France, Poland, and Sweden with a focus on local customer needs. Our beliefs: - Our ambition is to combine our passion for self-expression through fashion with our unwavering commitments to sustainability and D&I - We believe that our integration of fashion, operations, and online technology gives us the capability to deliver a compelling value proposition to both our customers and fashion brand partners.
